rv.q: The female characters — dressed (by David Zinn) in present-day duds and speaking with the careless diction of present-day youth — are the only ones not well-served in the production’s military environment.
Sadly, Gold's lethargic production never delivers on this expectation.

cn.t: Sam Gold's modern military-set *Othello* draws mixed notices: Variety applauds its raw, visceral energy, while others find it falls short of its bold ambitions. Daniel Craig and David Oyelowo headline the sold-out NYTW run.
